role: independent non-author verification of another worker's published measurement
independence_basis: worker-079 is not an author of, or contributor to, the frozen stage-B script, the R03-v2 candidate (worker-006), the worker-004 patch, the head-to-head corpus, the rule spec, the FROZEN manifest, or any canonical schema; worker-079 read only the pre-registration text, the manifest and the recorded report before freezing this instrument, and implemented its own runner rather than invoking the author's run_headtohead.py

disclosure.note: no corpus fixture, derived negative, or variant was executed by worker-079 before this file was written; the scoring rule below is transcribed from the pre-registration text of the target measurement, not from its report

frozen.rule: literal substring of binder in formal

cand_004.rule: every binder token present as a whole word in formal

fixture_manifest.rule: every fixture's bytes must hash to the manifest's declared sha256 before and after the run

derived_negative_set.root_rule: sha256 of the newline-joined sorted lines '<basename>:<sha256>'; drift voids the measurement
derived_negative_set.status: DERIVED regression set, not held out; counted separately from primary FP/FN

protocol.parser: json.load of the --json output; verdict and failed_rules are read; audited_at and other volatile keys are dropped before hashing

scoring_rules.primary_fp: scored pos fixtures with verdict != accept
scoring_rules.primary_fn: scored neg fixtures with verdict == accept
scoring_rules.edge_fp: probe fixtures (spec-legitimate, expected accept) with verdict != accept
scoring_rules.canonical_pos_accept: accept count over the 5 pos fixtures
scoring_rules.regression: over the 31 derived negatives: frozen_r03 = frozen verdict != accept and 'R03' in frozen failed_rules; reproduced = frozen_r03 and candidate verdict != accept; now_pass = frozen_r03 and candidate verdict == accept; now_pass_but_rejected_by_other_rules = frozen_r03 and candidate verdict != accept and 'R03' not in candidate failed_rules; now_pass_overall_accept = now_pass rows with candidate failed_rules empty
scoring_rules.adoption_rule: a candidate is measured SAFE at these bytes iff primary FP = 0 and primary FN = 0 and it accepts the 3 live canonical controls and loses no substantive frozen gate-negative catch; adoption is the owner's decision

expectations.check: frozen primary_fp set equals the recorded set
frozen primary_fn set equals the recorded set
frozen edge_fp set equals the recorded set
cand_r03v2 primary_fp and primary_fn are both empty
cand_r03v2 edge_fp set equals the recorded set
cand_004 primary_fp empty and primary_fn equals the recorded set
cand_004 edge_fp is empty and canonical_pos_accept equals 5/5
per-candidate regression triple (reproduced count, now_pass list, now_pass_but_other list, overall_accept list) equals the recorded claim for all three candidates
frozen control check: pos00 accept, pos01 accept, pos02 reject with R03
every fixture's frozen failed_rules is a subset of {R03}
non-R03 failed-rule sets are identical across the three variants on every fixture
all 264 cells produced parseable JSON and each cell's two runs agree after dropping volatile keys

controls.expected: 13/13 fixture bytes hash to the manifest values; a doctored manifest hash triggers exit 2 in the guard self-test
31 files hash to root 567cab34d32e8985; a doctored root triggers exit 2 in the guard self-test
every pinned file re-measured after the run equals the pre-run value; drift aborts with exit 2
a synthetic neg record with verdict accept classifies as FN; a synthetic pos record with verdict reject classifies as FP
the report core is byte-identical across two end-to-end runs
exactly 3 variants x 44 files x 2 runs = 264 invocations, all exit 0 with parseable JSON; anything less is INVALID

fail_closed: exit 2 with no report on any pin, fixture, manifest or derived-negative-root drift measured before or after the run
exit 3 with no report on any control failure
exit 4 with no report on any internal harness exception

report_semantics.VALID: instrument and controls pass; the computed tables are the measurement
report_semantics.DIFF: the instrument is VALID but at least one expectation fails; discrepancies are listed individually

falsifier: Re-run artifacts/worker-079/r03_verify/run_r03verify_079.py at the pins above: any control failure, any expectation flip versus this pre-registration, or any pin/fixture byte drift falsifies the verification result (drift voids the round rather than falsifying it).
not_claimed: schema-content correctness or a full-schema review
any theorem, physics result or class-binding adjudication
that the recorded candidate counts are 'true' beyond what re-execution at the pinned bytes shows
